title: A week of every train in Bangkok
description:
A week of every train in Bangkok, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Bangkok city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: BTS, Blue Line, Purple Line, Pink Line, Yellow Line and Red/ARL, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 214 trains, Monday at 7:30 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out King Bhumibol Memorial Day (October 13), Bangkok special holiday (October 16) and Chulalongkorn Day (October 23).
